claims.text: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio lists qwen3-max-2026-01-23 for international availability on January 27, describing merged thinking/non-thinking modes and built-in web search, web extraction, and code interpreter use during thinking.
The same lifecycle page records broad January 4 global availability for multiple Qwen3 and Wan 2.6 model families, including tool-oriented/coding and multimodal models.
Comparative capability language in the lifecycle catalog is vendor-reported and not independently reproduced.

limitations.text: Model Studio availability dates can differ by region and need to remain scoped to the listed deployment region.
The lifecycle page is living documentation; dated entries rather than current default aliases anchor January chronology.
